'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
***[[May 2023 Gaza–Israel clashes|2023 Gaza–Israel clashes]]
****An [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] kills two commanders of [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad]]. Additionally, the total death toll from the Israeli airstrikes in Gaza over the past two days increases to 26. A rocket is also launched from Gaza to [[Rehovot]], killing one person and injuring five others. *[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***[[Wagner Group]] leader [[Yevgeny Prigozhin]] confirms that [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] have recaptured parts of [[Bakhmut]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]] from his forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-routs-russia-brigade-kremlin-admits-campaign-very-difficult-2023-05-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Ministry of Defence (United Kingdom)|Defence Ministry]] confirms that it has supplied [[Ukraine]] with [[Storm Shadow]] [[cruise missile]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65558070 (BBC News)]

**Thirty-three people are killed and three more injured after gunmen open fire against vegetable farmers in [[Boucle du Mouhoun Region]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/civilians-killed-in-burkina-faso-attack-governor-says-/7092472.html (VOA)]

**The [[World Health Organization]] says that [[mpox]] no longer constitutes a [[Public health emergency of international concern|global health emergency]], but that it continues to remain a threat in [[Africa]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Mercedes-Benz factory shooting]]
**Two people are killed in a shooting at a [[Mercedes-Benz]] factory in [[Sindelfingen]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]]. The perpetrator is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-mercedes-benz-factory-shooting-5758c4d45cd96a0b6b4dd111eb954d9b (AP)]
*[[2023 Ratingen explosion]]
**Twelve people are injured in an explosion at an apartment complex in [[Ratingen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], [[Germany]]. A 57-year-old man is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-explosion-ratingen-police-injured-7071d58669979d0af5db8e6b3e4fa792 (AP)]
